projects.name: jansson
projects.notes: A reference-counted JSON library: json_incref/json_decref keep json_t::refcount with __atomic_add_fetch/__atomic_sub_fetch (inline in jansson.h), json_decref frees through json_delete in value.c, containers take a share of what is stored in them (json_object_set takes one, json_object_set_new does not). The corpus for RFC 0010: shares, releases, per-outcome stores. jansson_config.h is the configured header the build would generate; see support/jansson.

projects.name: lua
projects.notes: A garbage-collected VM, a few minutes as one program with a release build (see the timings in README.md). realloc through the l_alloc function pointer, a 968-block interpreter loop with computed goto (luaV_execute), linked stacks of locals in the parser. Stresses outcome-conditional summaries, dead-variable cleanup and analysis time; see the triage in README.md.
